These manifests record the 32 independently reviewed Ubuntu security updates used by the candidate Qwen images. Each revision and SHA256 came from freshly authenticated Ubuntu apt indexes. No CUDA, NVIDIA, NCCL, PyTorch or vLLM package belongs to this correction.

`apply_updates.py MANIFEST ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY` checks every archive hash, simulates the offline install, rejects additions/removals or a different revision set, installs only those upgrades from the verified local archives in apt dependency order inside a network-disabled build, audits configuration/dependency completeness with dpkg and apt, and compares the complete before/after dpkg inventory. Every other package must remain unchanged. Existing base configuration files are preserved with dpkg `--force-confold`; dependency errors remain fatal. It does not run apt autoremove or a general upgrade.

The `.deb` archives are build inputs downloaded from the recorded public URLs and checked against these manifests; they are not committed. Other available updates remain outside this reviewed correction, so this is not a claim that every OS package is current. Final image inventory, vulnerability scan, Python imports and real GPU/model checks remain separate gates.
